app.title: Microsoft 365 Archive
export.what.sub: Your selection is saved and also applies to the schedule. Every run fetches only what is new — a second run is quick.
export.channels.note: Team channels: every team you are a member of is exported. That can take a long time.
log.title: Log
search.sub.hybrid: Hybrid search: full text (BM25) and meaning (embeddings) fused.
search.sub.lexical: Full-text search only (BM25) — the embeddings for the semantic half are missing.
search.sub.none: There is no index yet. Export and index first.
cal.stats: {n} appointments in the calendar export · {r} reconstructed from mail · as of {when}
cal.st.deleted: Deleted — reconstructed from a cancellation mail
cal.st.gone: No longer in the calendar — reconstructed from mail
cal.rb.note: Appointments that are no longer in the calendar export and were recovered from invitation, reply or cancellation mails alone. “Deleted” means a cancellation mail exists. Click opens the source mail.
cal.rb.empty: No reconstructed appointments — the mailbox held no matching invitation or cancellation mails.
cal.missing: Calendar data is missing — start “Build calendar & contacts” on the Export tab.
sched.title: Export regularly
sched.sub: Runs only while this window, or the app, is open. After each export it can index straight away — for the search here and for the MCP server.
sched.token.note: The schedule only reaches as far as the access token stays valid — how long that is depends on your tenant and is shown on the token pill above. When it expires, the schedule skips the next run and the assistant opens; anything already exported is kept.
mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.sub: This lets Claude search the archive itself and answer with citations.
mcp.code.note: Add to Claude Code (.mcp.json in the project):
mcp.desktop.note: Claude Desktop only accepts command entries — use this instead of the URL:
settings.teams.title: Teams export
settings.teams.sub: Applies to the next run. Anything already exported stays as it is.
settings.embed_images: Embed inline images in the HTML
settings.cache_images.hint: — faster re-export, costs disk space twice
settings.refresh_channels: Check channels for new replies on every run
settings.skip_empty_chats: Skip chats without a real message
settings.outlook.title: Outlook export
settings.skip_folders.sub: Folders the default selection leaves out (one per line, case does not matter). Empty = export every folder.
settings.speed.title: Speed
settings.workers.hint: Graph allows 4 concurrent requests per mailbox — more mostly produces throttling. Use 1 on a flaky connection.
settings.batch.hint: Larger = fewer requests to Ollama, more memory per request.
settings.search.title: Search and MCP
settings.mcp_autostart: Start the MCP server with the app
settings.mcp.note: A changed port takes effect once the MCP server is restarted — and the entries in Claude have to follow.
settings.dirs.title: Folders
settings.dirs.sub: Relative to the data folder, or absolute. Changing one moves nothing — existing exports stay where they are.
settings.lang.title: Language
settings.lang.sub: Applies to this interface. Exported content and the output of the export scripts are untouched.
settings.saved: Saved — applies to the next run.
wizard.token.title: Fetch an access token
wizard.token.intro: This tool never signs you in. You fetch the token once in the Microsoft Graph Explorer and paste it here. How long it lasts is up to your tenant — anywhere from an hour to several.
wizard.token.none: No token is stored — without one nothing can be exported.
wizard.token.expired: The token has expired. Please fetch a fresh one.
wizard.token.missing: The token is missing these permissions: {list}. A wider one counts — if you have Mail.ReadWrite you do not need Mail.Read as well.
wizard.token.ok: Token valid for {who}, {rest} left. You only need a new one once it expires — this window will say so by itself.
wizard.token.step1: Open the Graph Explorer and sign in with your work account, top right.
wizard.token.step2: Consent to these permissions — tab Modify permissions, then Consent:
wizard.token.step2.note: That tab only lists permissions for the request currently in the address bar. If one is not offered, put the matching query in there, run it, and look again.
wizard.token.step3: Tab Access token: copy the long text in full.
wizard.token.privacy: The token stays local in gx_token.txt (readable only by you) and is sent to nothing but Microsoft Graph.
wizard.ollama.title: Set up Ollama (optional)
wizard.ollama.intro: Ollama computes the embeddings for semantic search. Everything runs locally, nothing leaves your machine.
wizard.ollama.off: Ollama is not running. Without it there is no semantic search — export, full-text search and MCP still work.
wizard.ollama.nomodel: Ollama is running, but the model {model} is still missing.
wizard.ollama.wait: Once that finishes this window will say so by itself — or click “Check again”
wizard.ollama.without: Continue without Ollama — full-text index only
wizard.ollama.without.note: “Continue without Ollama” builds a pure full-text index (BM25). Search and MCP work with it immediately; the semantic half can be added later at any time.
wizard.ollama.ready.title: Ollama is ready
wizard.ollama.ready: Ollama is running and the model {model} is there. The next index gets embeddings and search becomes hybrid.
wizard.ollama.step.mac1: Download Ollama from {url} and drag it into Applications
wizard.ollama.step.mac2: Start Ollama once (icon in the menu bar)
wizard.ollama.step.win1: Download OllamaSetup.exe from {url} and run it
wizard.ollama.step.win2: Ollama then starts automatically in the background
srv.job.cancel: Cancellation requested — the running step is being stopped.
srv.token.found: Token found for {account}, valid for another {rest}.
srv.token.scopes: Missing permissions: {list} — click the token pill above.
srv.token.none: No token stored — the assistant walks you through getting one.
srv.token.expired: The stored token has expired — the assistant is opening.
srv.token.saved.scopes: Still missing permissions: {list} — consent in the Graph Explorer and copy it again.
srv.token.short: That does not look like an access token.
srv.token.stale: That token has already expired — please copy a fresh one.
srv.mcp.noindex: No index available — MCP has nothing to serve.
srv.mcp.badaction: action must be start or stop.
srv.lexical.choice: Without embeddings by choice — the index is built as a pure full-text index (search without semantic hits).
srv.lexical.noollama: Ollama unavailable — the index is built as a pure full-text index (search without semantic hits).
srv.sched.notoken: Schedule skipped: no valid token — please paste a new one in the assistant.
srv.notoken: No token stored — please go through the assistant.
srv.nostart: The job could not be started.
srv.nomcpmodule: mcp_server could not be loaded ({error}) — 'pip install -r requirements.txt'?
wizard.token.ok.nowho: Token valid, {rest} left. You only need a new one once it expires — this window will say so by itself.
wizard.token.ok.unknown: Token valid for {who}. You only need a new one once it expires — this window will say so by itself.
wizard.token.ok.plain: Token valid. You only need a new one once it expires — this window will say so by itself.
update.title: Version
update.enabled.hint: — asks api.github.com once. Otherwise the app talks to nothing but Microsoft Graph and your local Ollama.
quit.confirm: Quit the app? The MCP server goes with it, and search will no longer be reachable.
quit.confirm.busy: A job is running. Quitting cancels it — anything already exported is kept and the next run continues from there. Quit anyway?
quit.done: Stopped. You can close this window. To carry on, just start the app again.
